Solve the recurrences T(n) = 2T(√n) + log n and T(n) = 4T(n/2) + n²√n.

Explain the N-Queen problem and solve the 4/5-queen problem using backtracking with the state-space tree.
Find an optimal parenthesisation of the matrix-chain product with the given dimensions.
Discuss Big-O and Big-Omega notations and prove that ½n(n−1) = O(n²) by finding c and n₀.
Find the topological sort of the given DAG and how many topological orderings it has.
